subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Indignation
solution:
The correct answer is "Offense"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the meaning of synonyms:

__
 
• **Indignation -** angry because of something that is wrong or not fair:

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** She wrote an *indignant *letter to the paper complaining about the council's action.
 
 
 
• **​Offense - **the condition of having your feelings hurt esp. because someone has been rude or showed a lack of respect: 
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Do you think he took *offense* (= was upset) at the joke about his age?​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's learn some other word meanings:

 
• **Designation - **an official title or name:

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** What's her official *designation *now she's been promoted?
 
 
 
• **​Resignation - **the act of telling your employer that you are leaving your job:
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***There have been calls for his* resignation.*
 
 
 
• **Defence - **the act of protecting someone or something against attack or criticism :
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He published an essay in *defence* of the freedom of the press.
